sources.title: FINER-SQL: Boosting Small Language Models for Text-to-SQL
sources.snippet: To overcome these issues, we propose FINER-SQL, a scalable and reusable reinforcement learning framework that enhances SLMs through fine-grained execution feedback. Built on group relative policy optimization, FINER-SQL replaces sparse supervision with dense and interpretable rewards that offer continuous feedback even for incorrect SQLs.

sources.title: FINER-SQL: Boosting Small Language Models for Text-to-SQL
sources.snippet: Large language models have driven major advances in Text-to-SQL generation. However, they suffer from high computational cost, long latency, and data privacy concerns, which make them impractical for many real-world applications.
